intro: Global technology and cybersecurity sectors bore the brunt of 69 ai-security incidents tracked from April to August 2026, with government, critical infrastructure, and financial services also affected. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed across these campaigns. High-severity issues dominated the mix, including CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), alongside CVE-2026-44339, CVE-2026-44567, and CVE-2026-45303. Impact spanned the United States, China, and broader North America, with 32 high and 9 critical findings recorded.
